# Payflow SA

> Payflow SA is payroll software built for South African small and medium-sized businesses.

## What Payflow SA does

- Captures employee hours and payroll inputs.
- Helps businesses run payroll and review payroll totals.
- Generates and exports payslips.
- Organises employee, company and payroll information in one Android application.
- Supports South African payroll workflows and Rand values.

## Who it is for

Payflow SA is designed for South African SMEs, business owners, payroll administrators, bookkeepers and employers who want a simpler payroll workflow than spreadsheets.

## Pricing and trial

The website currently offers a first month free for new customers. Pricing and plan details are published on the website and should be treated as the current source of truth.

## Support

Customers can contact Payflow SA through the WhatsApp call-to-action on the website.

## Important limitation

Payflow SA is a payroll calculation and workflow aid. Employers remain responsible for entering accurate information, reviewing payroll results and meeting their applicable legal, tax and submission obligations.

## Canonical website

https://mypayflowsa.co.za/
